title: Get the post privacy settings of a TikTok account
content_data:
Use this endpoint to obtain the post privacy settings of a TikTok account. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/video/settings/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Access token authorized by TikTok creators.
To obtain an access token, use [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1833997638479041).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | | business_id {Required} | string | Application specific unique identifier for the TikTok account.

Pass the value of the `open_id` field returned in the response of [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1833997638479041) to this field.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/video/settings/?business_id={{business_id}}' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #| privacy_level_options | string[] | The available privacy level options for the TikTok account's posts.

  • If the TikTok account is a public account, the enum values are:
    • `PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE`: Everyone (people on or off TikTok).
    • `MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS`: Friends (followers you follow back).
    • `SELF_ONLY`: Only you.
  • If the TikTok account is a private account, the enum values are:
    • `FOLLOWER_OF_CREATOR`: Followers (Visible only to followers on your private account).
    • `MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS`: Friends (followers you follow back).
    • `SELF_ONLY`: Only you.
| #| comment_disabled | boolean | Whether the "Allow comments" setting is available for the TikTok account's posts.

Supported values:
  • `true`: unavailable. You cannot enable the setting for the TikTok account's posts.
    • If you have set the comment privacy settings for your TikTok account as allowing comments from No one, this field will be `true`.
  • `false`: available. You can either enable or disable the setting for the TikTok account's posts.
| #| duet_disabled | boolean | Whether the "Allow Duets" setting is available for the TikTok account's posts.

Supported values:
  • `true`: unavailable. You cannot enable the setting for the TikTok account's posts.
    • If you have set the Duet privacy settings for your TikTok account as allowing Duet from Only you or if your TikTok account is a private account, this field will be `true`.
  • `false`: available. You can either enable or disable the setting for the TikTok account's posts.
| #| stitch_disabled | boolean | Whether the "Allow Stitch" setting is available for the TikTok account's posts.

Supported values:
  • `true`: unavailable. You cannot enable the setting for the TikTok account's posts.
    • If you have set the Stitch privacy settings for your TikTok account as allowing Stitch from Only you or if your TikTok account is a private account, this field will be `true`.
  • `false`: available. You can either enable or disable the setting for the TikTok account's posts.
| #| max_video_post_duration_sec | number | The maximum duration for video posts that the TikTok account can publish in seconds.

If you attempt to publish a video post longer than the maximum duration via [/business/video/publish/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1762228496095234), the publishing attempt will fail. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "comment_disabled": false, "duet_disabled": false, "max_video_post_duration_sec": 600, "privacy_level_options": [ "PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE", "MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS", "SELF_ONLY" ], "stitch_disabled": false } } (/code) ```
